2609.11699.title: Negative Self-Distillation: Learning to Reason by Avoiding Flaws
2609.11699.paper_summary: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) has emerged as a popular paradigm for large language model (LLM) self-improvement, allowing models to act as their own teachers by leveraging privileged information such as ground-truth solutions. However, recent findings indicate that OPSD can severely degrade the performance of LLMs on complex reasoning tasks: By forcing the student to imitate an artificially confident reasoning trace conditioned on privileged information, OPSD inadvertently suppresses expressions of uncertainty and penalizes the exploratory, self-corrective behaviors required to solve challenging problems. To address this, we introduce Negative Self-Distillation (NSD), a new framework that optimizes LLMs by diverging from flawed reasoning rather than imitating privileged solutions. Instead of relying on ground-truth answers or external supervision, NSD uses the model itself to generate a question-specific negative condition (eg, acting as a ``careless reasoner'') and pushes the student's distribution away from this self-generated negative teacher. Naively applying unlearning objectives to achieve this divergence is problematic, as flawed reasoning tokens are confounded with basic linguistic tokens; indiscriminately penalizing both risks catastrophically degrading the model's foundational language capabilities. We resolve this by designing a dynamic gating mechanism that automatically identifies and isolates reasoning-critical tokens, ensuring gradient updates target only behavioral flaws while preserving the model's linguistic priors. Empirically, NSD consistently outperforms OPSD and other label-free, self-bootstrapping reinforcement learning (RL) baselines.
2609.11699.paper_summary_zh: 在政策自蒸餾（OPSD）已成為大型語言模型（LLM）自我改進的一個熱門範式，允許模型利用如真實解答等特權信息充當自己的教師。然而，最近的研究結果表明，OPSD 可能會嚴重降低 LLM 在複雜推理任務上的表現：通過強迫學生模仿基於特權信息的人工自信推理痕跡，OPSD 無意中抑制了不確定性的表達，並懲罰了解決挑戰性問題所需的探索性、自我修正行為。為了解決這個問題，我們提出了負自蒸餾（NSD），這是一個新的框架，通過偏離有缺陷的推理而不是模仿特權解決方案來優化 LLM。NSD 不依賴於真實答案或外部監督，而是利用模型本身生成問題特定的負條件（例如，充當“粗心的推理者”），並將學生的分佈推離這個自生成的負教師。天真地應用去學習目標以實現這種偏離是有問題的，因為有缺陷的推理標記與基本語言標記混淆；不加區分地懲罰兩者都有可能災難性地降低模型的基礎語言能力。我們通過設計一個動態閘控機制來解決這個問題，該機制自動識別和隔離關鍵的推理標記，確保梯度更新僅針對行為缺陷，同時保留模型的語言先驗。在實證上，NSD 一直優於 OPSD 和其他無標籤、自我引導的增強學習（RL）基準。
